The refreshed interim report supports H1 2026 revenue and product growth, the 48.3% consumables result, cloud activity, lower gross margin, adjusted loss, operating cash outflow, inventory and liquidity evidence.

summary: Completed Creality's first immutable scenario-complete assessment after the canonical HKD mark recovered. Primary evidence supports very high direct theme exposure and a strong utilization-to-consumables signal, but printer stagnation, lower margin, adjusted loss, negative operating cash flow and private-competitor pressure constrain quality. HKD10/HKD18/HKD32 scenarios at 30%/50%/20% yield HKD18.40 probability-weighted value, -29.23% expected return, HKD14.40 buy-below and -44.44% margin of safety versus HKD26. The deterministic conclusion is Sell / Avoid; no strategy, signal, order or accounting state was created. The candidate relationship remains pending and exactly one dependent idea refresh was enqueued.
